principle: Measure observable answer changes under deterministic transformations whose formal status is explicit. Do not infer categorical or proof-theoretic structure.

transformations.description: Reverse the order of the same premise multiset. The formal problem and gold label are unchanged; only serialization order changes.
Replace domain nouns with deterministic neutral atom labels while preserving the same propositional template and query polarity.
transformations.reason_disabled: Requires an explicit audited atom-to-renderer mapping before confirmatory use.

transformations.description: Expose an additional formally valid intermediate statement.
transformations.reason_disabled: Deferred until a stronger same-context derivation representation is justified by data.

transformations.description: Render the same three-premise formal problem under all six permutations of premise order.
transformations.motivation: Provides an exact finite transformation family with identity and composition inherited from S3, allowing empirical tests of whether response changes depend systematically on permutation structure without changing premises, gold label, or query.
transformations.caution: Any representation or composition claim concerns observed response structure only; group/category language is not licensed unless the fitted response law generalizes beyond the construction used to define it.

transformations.description: Fix a prefix trace and vary the continuation and the query. Rows are prefixes, columns are (continuation, query) tests, cells are the answer-logit pair in R^2.
transformations.formal_status: same_clause_multiset_within_row_class; gold by generator forward chaining, not Lean-certified per cell
transformations.motivation: Estimates the finite restriction of the recognition congruence defined in recognition-paths (RecognitionPaths/Recognition.lean), which is what the Recognition Factorization Theorem compares with logical identity.
transformations.caution: Rank, clustering, and separation statistics describe the finite table only. They are not evidence that the model realises the logical quotient.

transformations.description: Read each logit cell only through order relations: the decision [pos > neg] and, for two queries after the same continuation, the preference [margin(q1) > margin(q2)]. Threshold-free and invariant to the common logit offset.
transformations.formal_status: readout_only; no change to the formal problem
transformations.motivation: Makes the observation table a Boolean Chu space, the same kind of object as the logical table, so the canonical map F : L -> B is checked by exact equality rather than a metric tolerance.

transformations.description: Repeat a continuation clause (a.a) or the whole prefix (u.u).
transformations.motivation: Logical invariance forces ww ≈ w (Recognition.lean); this is its direct test.

transformations.description: Exchange body and head of one single-atom clause in place: minimal surface change, logical change (gold row must differ).
transformations.formal_status: changes_formal_problem; gold by forward chaining, not Lean-certified per cell
transformations.motivation: Contrast with permutations (maximal surface change, no logical change) to decide whether within-class behavioral proximity tracks logic or words.
